title: Welfare and health
question: Which record shows stronger support for government-guaranteed health coverage and income support for the general population?
highPole: government guarantees broad health coverage and income support
lowPole: government's role in health coverage and income support is cut back

items.text: Voted for a law that enrolls every resident in publicly funded health coverage with no charge at the point of care.
Voted to raise the minimum public pension and to tie unemployment benefits to wage growth.
Voted against a budget that reduced public health spending.
Publicly pressed fellow legislators to drop a proposed charge for doctor visits.
Announced the intention to introduce a bill adding dental and eye care to public coverage.
Voted to keep existing public health coverage for older and low-income residents at its current funding.
Voted against a bill extending public health coverage to all residents.
Voted against a bill narrowing eligibility for existing public health coverage.
Endorsed a proposal to subsidize private insurance premiums for middle-income households.
Said they will vote for stricter job-search conditions on unemployment benefits while keeping benefit levels unchanged.
Voted for a budget that reduced funding for public health coverage and narrowed eligibility for it.
Voted to add work requirements and time limits to income support for working-age adults.
Voted against extending subsidies for health insurance premiums.
Publicly urged fellow legislators to turn public health funding into fixed grants that grow more slowly than costs.
Announced the intention to introduce a bill letting people leave public health coverage in exchange for a tax credit.
